ctx.x: We played the Apollo Theatre, as I said, 21 times, and we worked with the original Cotton Club Boys and Girls, and their names, I can't think of them all right now -- you know Honey Cole, was one of them.

Yeah, Charlie Atkinson -- great dancers, and the girls' names I can't remember. Beautiful shows, and we had black and white shows. But of course, Barnet had made -- da da da -- mpton Poppin Turnpike was one of the big hits in Harlem, and another thing we made was -- oh, what was the name of it -- yeah, Tappin' at the Tapper.
